name: Bithal Das Mundhra
current_role: Chairman Emeritus, Simplex Infrastructures Ltd (Kolkata); formerly Chairman & Managing Director
profile: Patriarch of the Kolkata Mundhra family, which bought Simplex (a British-owned piling firm founded in 1924) in 1947 and grew it into a large Indian EPC/infrastructure contractor. He ran it as Chairman & MD. Simplex is now led by the next generation (Rajiv and Amitabh Mundhra), and he holds the title of Chairman Emeritus.
interesting_fact: Simplex started in 1924 as a British-owned piling company. The Mundhra family acquired it in 1947, listed it in 1996 as Simplex Concrete Piles (India), and renamed it Simplex Infrastructures in 2005.
deep_cut_fact: Born in 1942, he began his construction career at 19 on Simplex's construction sites before rising to lead the company.
notes: Born 1942; no recent public activity found, so his status is unconfirmed. The email is Simplex's general registered-office (Kolkata) address, not a personal one. The NBMCW source page now returns 404 (fact seen in a search snippet). One 2010 quote credits Simplex's growth to 'honest hard work, a progressive attitude and adaptability'.
